name: Refreshing
overview: Scripture reveals that true refreshing comes from a steadfast focus on the LORD, who restores the soul and leads believers in righteousness (Psalms 16:8; 23:3). This renewal involves humbly fearing God and turning away from evil (Proverbs 3:7), resulting in renewed strength and endurance that enable the believer to rise above weariness (Isaiah 40:31). God satisfies the weary and replenishes the sorrowful, offering spiritual refreshment that sustains the soul (Jeremiah 31:25). Additionally, the Spirit of truth guides believers into all truth, providing ongoing spiritual refreshment through divine guidance (John 16:13).
